posts.title: Welcome to FTI Protocol
posts.text:
Welcome to FTI Protocol

The official channel for project announcements, platform updates and guidance across the FTI ecosystem.

Website: https://ftiprotocol.com/
Member application: https://ftiprotocol.com/app/
Token application: https://ftiprotocol.com/token/

FTI operates on BNB Smart Chain mainnet. Review the details in the application and your wallet before authorizing any operation.

Begin with the platform links above and follow this channel for official updates.

posts.title: Explore the FTI Ecosystem
posts.text:
Explore the FTI Ecosystem

FTI connects membership, a binary structure and a reserve-based token model.

The member application provides account information and management features. The token application presents token information and related operations.

Explore the platform and choose the application relevant to your needs:
https://ftiprotocol.com/

FTI Protocol | Official
@FTIProtocol_Official

#FTIProtocol #FTIEcosystem #PlatformGuide

posts.title: Connect Your Wallet
posts.text:
Connect Your Wallet

Open the member application:
https://ftiprotocol.com/app/

1. Select the wallet connection option.
2. Choose a connection method supported by your wallet.
3. Confirm BNB Smart Chain mainnet, chain ID 56.

Wallet connection, registration and transaction approval are separate steps. Review each subsequent request before approving it.

FTI Protocol | Official

#FTIProtocol #WalletGuide #BNBSmartChain

posts.title: Check Your Referral Details
posts.text:
Check Your Referral Details

If you received an FTI referral link, use it to begin registration.

Before confirming, compare the referrer address shown in the application with the address provided to you. Resolve any discrepancy before proceeding.

If you need assistance, retain the referral link and exact error message so the issue can be reviewed.

posts.title: Understand the Reserve Model
posts.text:
Understand the Reserve Model

Reserves and token supply contribute to the calculation of the FTI token’s internal price.

This calculation does not guarantee returns or a fixed token price. Review current token information and the terms shown for each operation.

Read the details in the token application before proceeding:
https://ftiprotocol.com/token/

posts.title: Verify the FTI Token
posts.text:
Verify the FTI Token

A token name or symbol alone does not establish its identity. Check the network and contract address together.

Network: BNB Smart Chain mainnet
FTI token contract:
0x43755B1E813b2d41F669ea08bcf859De07195eA1

Compare this address with the current information in the token application:
https://ftiprotocol.com/token/

posts.title: Review Your Activity
posts.text:
Review Your Activity

The activity history section shows the status of its data request and displays a notice if new information cannot be retrieved.

When previously retrieved information is shown, review the accompanying freshness notice.

Check your wallet and the network explorer to confirm a transaction’s final status.

The release also includes a more compact membership card and updated light and dark theme controls.

posts.title: Request Technical Assistance
posts.text:
Request Technical Assistance

Help support review your issue by including:

• The page and action involved
• The exact error message
• Your device and browser
• The approximate time of the incident

Include a screenshot if useful, with confidential information removed. Never disclose your wallet recovery phrase or private key.

Send your report to the contact address listed on the website:
Support@FTIProtocol.com

posts.title: Getting Started
posts.text:
Getting Started

Is a wallet required to view public information?
Public information in the member and token applications can be viewed without connecting a wallet.

Does wallet connection complete registration?
Connection, registration and transaction approval are separate steps.

Begin with the member application:
https://ftiprotocol.com/app/

For the main platform links, refer to this channel’s introductory post.
